messages:
alex: quick check — PR #20421 is sitting in the merge queue but CI keeps failing on one test shard. failing test: transformer_cache_test::kv_eviction. can someone kick a rerun or confirm it's flaky? https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/20421/builds/789
ci-bot: build 789 — shard 7 — failed on 1 test (transformer_cache_test::kv_eviction). logs: https://logs.example/789/shard7. rerun instructions: `bk rerun 789 --shard 7`
maria: on it. i can repro locally sometimes, appears unstable under CPU contention. will try a targeted rerun first.
josh: fyi i pushed the kv cache small change in #20390 last week, might be related to eviction timing. saw a similar timing edge in my local stress runs.
alex: thanks. if it's timeout/timing we might be hitting a race that only shows under our shard config. maria — if you can reproduce, can you add a quick guard or increase timeout in the flaky test? if not, a snapshot update might be wrong.
maria: starting targeted rerun now. @karen can you approve builder restart if needed? (we're low on concurrency and merge queue is backing up)
karen: give me 3 mins, i'm finishing a review.
ci-bot: rerun started for build 789 (shard 7) — triggered by maria.
maria: rerun finished — still failing, reproduces consistently on my GCP dev worker when I run `bazel test //runtime:transformer_cache_test --test_arg=--shard=7`. adding logs now.
josh: interesting — the failure stack shows `kv_cache::evict_if_full()` returning empty while caller assumes non-empty. could be missing null-check after eviction. I'll drop a tiny PR with a safe check.
triage-bot: label: flaky-test-investigation added to PR #20421.
alex: small process note — if a flaky test blocks merge queue for >30m, please ping eng oncall and the CI queue team. we should avoid long backlogs.
maria: i pushed a test-only guard (no behavior change) + extra log. PR #20422 -> links: https://github.com/redwood/prs/20422. also updated the failing snapshot assertion to be tolerant of empty eviction.
josh: looked at #20422 — code change is fine. can we avoid snapshot update if it's a true bug?
maria: agreed — the test update is just to make the assertion safe while we validate root cause. will revert snapshot changes once we confirm.
karen: reviewed #20422, left one nit. approving after nit fix.
maria: nit fixed. thanks.
ci-bot: build 790 for PR #20422 started (full CI).
ci-bot: build 790 passed.
karen: approved. alex — you ok to merge #20422 and then requeue #20421?
alex: yes merging the guard PR now, will requeue 20421 and trigger a targeted rerun on shard 7.
ci-bot: PR #20422 merged by alex — merge queue position updated.
ci-bot: rerun started for PR #20421 (targeted shard 7).
ci-bot: rerun finished — build 791 passed all shards.
alex: great — merging #20421. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :tada:
maria: noted a follow-up todo to add a regression test covering the eviction edge. filing an issue.
triage-bot: issue created: #412 — add eviction-edge regression test.
alex: headed out for standup. if the merge queue gets stuck again ping me. thanks!
